title: Canine Distemper Virus Research in China and Future Directions for Conservation中国犬瘟热病毒研究现状与保护策略展望
content:
ABSTRACT

Canine distemper is a highly contagious, severe disease caused by the canine distemper virus (CDV). With a worldwide distribution and ever-expanding list of susceptible hosts, CDV poses a growing risk for many threatened wildlife species, both in captivity and their native habitats. As a megadiverse country, China is home to myriad endemic and threatened species, many of which have the potential to be impacted by a CDV outbreak. To understand China's current priorities for CDV research, we conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of published CDV research performed in China. Qualified results were collated from multiple databases, and data concerning the research topic and host species were categorized. We utilized Pearson's Chi-squared test and standardized Pearson residuals to identify and measure deviations from the expected proportions of research distribution. We found that there were significant biases in all groupings tested. The research was significantly biased toward domestic animals, in-vitro laboratory work, and farmed animals, and the research topics of detection, phylogenetics, and viral structure and function. After further excluding species not of conservation concern, we found the remaining research significantly biased toward captive species. Threatened native species were significantly more represented in this subset of literature than non-native or those with lower IUCN statuses. Bias in research topics for the subset also varied, shifting to have significantly more work done on the topics of surveillance, phylogenetics, and prevention. More work is necessary to better understand and address the threat of CDV infections to susceptible wild populations in China. Work done in-vitro and in domestic, farmed, and captive populations can set a foundation of knowledge, from which to expand and apply to wild populations.

摘要

犬瘟热是由犬瘟热病毒 (CDV) 引起的一种严重的高接触性传染病。犬瘟热病毒在全球广泛分布, 且易感宿主名单不断扩大, 这对圈养及自然栖息地中的众多濒危野生动物物种构成了日益严重的威胁。作为生物多样性大国, 中国拥有众多特有物种与濒危物种, 其中相当一部分可能受到犬瘟热病毒暴发的威胁。为明确中国当前犬瘟热病毒研究的重点方向, 我们对国内已发表的CDV研究成果进行了系统综述和Meta分析。从多个数据库中筛选整理了符合纳入标准的研究结果, 并对研究主题和宿主物种相关信息进行了分类汇总。本研究采用Pearson卡方检验及标准化Pearson残差, 对研究分布偏离预期比例的程度进行了识别与量化。结果显示, 所有检验分组均存在显著偏倚。具体而言, 研究对象显著集中于家养动物、体外实验及养殖动物；研究主题则明显偏向检测、系统发育学以及病毒结构与功能。在进一步排除非受关注保护物种后, 我们发现剩余研究的分布显著偏向于圈养物种。在该文献子集中, 受威胁的本土物种所占比显著高于非本土物种或IUCN受胁等级较低的物种。同时, 该子集内研究主题的偏倚格局亦发生变化, 转向在监测、系统发育学及预防领域呈现出显著的研究集聚效应。为更全面地认知并有效应对CDV感染对我国易感野生动物种群构成的威胁, 亟需进一步深入开展研究。当前, 基于体外实验及家养、养殖和圈养种群所积累的研究成果, 可为后续知识体系的拓展及其向野外种群的转化应用奠定基础。
